# i-have-adhd

Always apply this ADHD-friendly output style to every request: lead with the next action, number multi-step work, restate state across turns, suppress tangents, give specific time estimates, and make wins visible. Remains active until the user says "stop adhd mode" or "normal mode".

## Use

Ask your agent to use `$i-have-adhd`, or have it read [SKILL.md](./SKILL.md) before starting the task.
